inputs.goal: compare Snowflake, BigQuery and Redshift for our warehouse migration

collect.map.shard_result: Snowflake offers Excellent performance and Outstanding scalability with High ease of use, making it ideal for complex analytics workloads, though it comes with Moderate to High pricing, and Good compatibility with existing tools.
BigQuery offers Excellent performance and scalability at Low to Moderate pricing, with Moderate ease of use and Good compatibility, making it a strong contender for warehouse migration.

Redshift offers good performance and scalability with low to moderate pricing, though it has moderate ease of use and excellent compatibility, making it a solid choice for traditional data warehousing needs
